g.text: Entry points
Styles and assets
Core
External
index.html · one div#root and one module script, nothing else
src/main.jsx · createRoot plus StrictMode, drops App into #root
package.json · dev, build, preview, and a deploy script
App.css · #root capped at 1280 px, .app is a three-row grid of 2.8rem, 1fr, 2.8rem
Navbar, MainContent and Footer css · one file per component
reset.css · box-sizing and margin 0, imported last so it lands after the other sheets
App.css @font-face · Didact Gothic woff2 pulled from fonts.gstatic.com at runtime
src/assets/s1.png, s2.png, s3.png · no component imports them, three dead mockup shots
App.jsx · grid shell: Navbar, MainContent, Footer in three rows
Navbar.jsx · three links, all href ./ — home, work and contact are the same page
MainContent.jsx · intro paragraphs plus a six-item What we do list, hardcoded copy
Footer.jsx · one copyright span, ellipsis when the window is narrow
App passes className down · every child ignores props and hardcodes its class
App.jsx · useState count is declared and never read, a Vite scaffold leftover
GitHub Pages · d3nd3.github.io/frank-react, vite base is /frank-react/
npm run deploy · touch dist/.nojekyll, then gh-pages -t -d dist publishes the built tree
fonts.gstatic.com · the only runtime request that is not our own origin
